description.value: COFU is a fully plant-based Japanese restaurant in Vancouver's Chinatown, founded by Akiko Gulkison, a Japanese immigrant and single mother who built Canada's first fully plant-based omakase experience. The intimate 18-course tasting menu is served at an 8-seat counter handcrafted by Japanese carpenters, blending traditional technique with seasonal vegetables sourced locally and from Japan. On weekends, the same address also houses Hush, a quiet coffee space serving Japanese-roasted beans and ceremonial-grade matcha from Kyoto.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is rich and confirms this is a real, active business. OSM tags (diet:vegan=only, diet:vegetarian=yes, phone, address) are all corroborated by the website. No bike-related amenities, washrooms, or water refill are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those fields default to null per the absence-of-evidence rule. The 100% vegan and gluten-free accommodation is explicitly stated on the FAQ page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant with a confirmed website, address, and phone. Notable destination for plant-based touring cyclists.
